definitions.gloss: dying young; premature death; early death
definitions.explanation: Death at a young age, particularly of a person with talent or promise. A literary and formal word that carries a tone of tragedy and loss of potential.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十歳|さんじっさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{夭折|ようせつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The genius painter died young at thirty.

examples.japanese: {夭折|ようせつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{再|さい}{評価|ひょうか}→再評価：28226_saihyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The works of the poet who died young are being reevaluated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もし→もし：01284_moshi⟧{夭折|ようせつ}⟦しなければ→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わっていた→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧だろう。
examples.english: If he hadn't died young, the history of music would have been very different.

notes:
A compound of {夭|よう} (young death, premature) and {折|せつ} (break, snap). The character {夭|よう} specifically refers to dying before one's time. A literary and somewhat formal word, typically used when discussing artists, writers, musicians, or other talented individuals whose lives were cut short.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夭折|ようせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to die young
- {夭折|ようせつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧: a genius who died young
- {夭折|ようせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧/⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧/⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: a painter/poet/writer who died young
- ⟦{惜|お}しまれ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧つつ{夭折|ようせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to die young, mourned by many

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {早世|そうせい}: dying young — a near-synonym, slightly less literary
- {急逝|きゅうせい}: sudden death — emphasizes the unexpectedness, not necessarily youth
- {若死|わかじ}に: dying young — more colloquial and direct
